# Native modules API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/native.json</code></div>

Load and call native modules through JSON.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.native.load`

`load(name) -> boolean`

Loads a native module. The load error is not reported to the script.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Native module name. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — True when the module loaded.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.native.load('mymodule')
```

### `caffeine.native.call`

`call(module, fn[, argsJson]) -> string`

Calls a function of a loaded native module with JSON arguments.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `module` | string | Module name. |
| `fn` | string | Function name. |
| `argsJson` | string | JSON arguments (default "{}"). |

**Returns:** `string` — The result text; on failure the error message is returned instead.

**Example**

```lua
local out = caffeine.native.call('mymodule', 'ping', '{}')
```
